# Jira Issue Retrieval

This feature retrieves Jira issues based on provided keys. It supports live retrieval from the Jira REST API or from a pre-fetched JSON cache, depending on the configuration. The system allows users to collect specific issue data for further processing in their workflow, enhancing integration with Jira.
